posts.title: You are an elitist
posts.description: Expertise and status do not entitle anyone to dismiss the people who have to live with their decisions. I want to challenge that habit in myself as well.

posts.title: I am angry.
posts.description: I am angry about preventable failures, unaccountable institutions and necessary work pushed onto the people with the least power to change the system.

posts.title: Critical infrastructure is maintained by people you have never heard of
posts.description: I write about the quiet maintenance behind critical software infrastructure: compatibility judgement, regression tests, release discipline and review work by people who rarely appear in public stories about technology.
